name: Adsroid – AI Agent for Advertising
author: adsroid

sections.description:
Adsroid is a conversational AI agent that helps advertisers optimize their Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn and more — in plain language, in real time. No dashboards. No complexity. Just results.

This free WordPress plugin connects your site to Adsroid with two standalone features:

Tracking — works without any account

Install and manage all your tracking pixels from one place — no code needed:

  • Google Tag Manager (recommended)
  • Meta Pixel
  • Google Analytics (GA4)
  • Google Ads Tag
  • Microsoft Ads (UET)
  • TikTok Pixel
  • Snapchat Pixel
  • Pinterest Tag

Simply enter your GTM ID or pixel IDs and they are automatically injected on every page of your site. If GTM is active, manual pixels are disabled to avoid duplicate tracking.

SEO Content — connect to Adsroid

Link your WordPress site to your Adsroid account so that Adsroid can publish optimized SEO articles on your site automatically. Once connected, no further action is required on your end.

What is Adsroid?

Adsroid is an AI agent for advertising. Ask it anything about your campaigns in plain language and get instant, data-backed answers. Adsroid connects to Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4 and more via official APIs.

Try Adsroid for free at adsroid.com — no credit card required.

How it works

  1. Install the plugin
  2. Go to Adsroid > Tracking to set up your pixels — no account needed
  3. Go to Adsroid > SEO to connect your site to Adsroid
  4. That is it — your site grows on autopilot

Privacy

This plugin does not collect any personal data on its own. The tracking scripts you choose to activate are subject to the privacy policies of their respective platforms. The API key generated by this plugin is stored locally in your WordPress database and is only shared when you choose to connect your site to Adsroid.

External Services

This plugin connects to several third-party services to provide tracking functionality. These connections are only established when you explicitly enter the corresponding pixel ID or GTM ID in the plugin settings.

Adsroid (adsroid.com)

Used to publish automated SEO content on your WordPress site via the REST API. This connection is only active when you provide your API key in the SEO tab.
Data sent: WordPress post data (title, content, categories) sent from Adsroid to your site.
– Service: https://adsroid.com
– Terms of Service: https://adsroid.com/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://adsroid.com/privacy/

Google Tag Manager

Used to inject the GTM container script on all public pages of your site when a GTM ID is provided.
Data sent: Page URL and browser metadata sent to Google servers on each page load.
– Service: https://tagmanager.google.com
– Terms of Service: https://www.google.com/analytics/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Meta Pixel

Used to inject the Meta Pixel script on all public pages when a Pixel ID is provided.
Data sent: Page view events and browser metadata sent to Meta servers on each page load.
– Service: https://www.facebook.com/business/tools/meta-pixel
– Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Google Analytics (GA4)

Used to inject the GA4 tracking script on all public pages when a GA4 Measurement ID is provided.
Data sent: Page view events and browser metadata sent to Google servers on each page load.
– Service: https://analytics.google.com
– Terms of Service: https://www.google.com/analytics/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Ads Tag

Used to inject the Google Ads conversion tracking script when a Google Ads Tag ID is provided.
Data sent: Page view events sent to Google servers on each page load.
– Service: https://ads.google.com
– Terms of Service: https://www.google.com/intl/en/policies/terms/
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Microsoft Advertising (UET)

Used to inject the Microsoft UET tag script when a UET Tag ID is provided.
Data sent: Page view events sent to Microsoft servers on each page load.
– Service: https://about.ads.microsoft.com
– Terms of Service: https://about.ads.microsoft.com/en-us/resources/policies/microsoft-advertising-agreement
– Privacy Policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement

TikTok Pixel

Used to inject the TikTok Pixel script when a Pixel ID is provided.
Data sent: Page view events sent to TikTok servers on each page load.
– Service: https://ads.tiktok.com
– Terms of Service: https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/us/privacy-policy/en

Snapchat Pixel

Used to inject the Snap Pixel script when a Pixel ID is provided.
Data sent: Page view events sent to Snapchat servers on each page load.
– Service: https://businesshelp.snapchat.com
– Terms of Service: https://snap.com/en-US/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://snap.com/en-US/privacy/privacy-policy

Pinterest Tag

Used to inject the Pinterest Tag script when a Tag ID is provided.
Data sent: Page view events sent to Pinterest servers on each page load.
– Service: https://business.pinterest.com
– Terms of Service: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/terms-of-service
– Privacy Policy: https://policy.pinterest.com/en/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the adsroid folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Adsroid in the main navigation menu to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Do I need an Adsroid account to use this plugin?

No. The Tracking tab works fully without an account. An Adsroid account is only required to use the automated SEO content feature.

What happens if I use GTM and also fill in pixel IDs?

If a GTM ID is entered, all manual pixels are automatically disabled to prevent duplicate tracking.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin only injects lightweight tracking snippets via standard WordPress hooks. No external libraries are loaded by the plugin itself.

Is it safe to regenerate my API key?

Yes, but make sure to update the new key in your Adsroid dashboard immediately — the old key will stop working right away.
